osps_ac_04_01_justification: GitHub defaults new workflows to read-only and Blanc grants write scopes only to jobs that require them. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-project-safeguards-2026-09-04.md
osps_br_02_01_justification: Every release uses a unique SemVer package version and immutable matching Git tag. Current evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/releases/tag/v1.17.0
osps_br_04_01_justification: Each GitHub release and repository release note has a human-readable changelog of functional and security-relevant changes. Current note: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/press/release-notes/v1.17.0.md
osps_br_05_01_justification: Blanc uses npm manifests and committed lockfiles; CI and release jobs install with npm ci. Dependency evidence and SBOM generation are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/compliance/README.md
osps_br_06_01_justification: v1.17.0 publishes a Sigstore-authenticated SHA256SUMS covering every release asset, plus platform signatures and provenance. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/release-incidents/2026-09-13-v1.17.0.md
osps_do_06_01_justification: Committed npm lockfiles select and obtain dependencies; weekly Dependabot proposals track them; policy, SBOM generation, and license review are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/compliance/README.md
osps_do_07_01_justification: Node.js 22, npm ci, local run, build, test, site, dependency, and platform-validation instructions are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_gv_01_01_justification: The sole human maintainer and the sensitive project-resource domains they can access are listed at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/governance.md
osps_gv_01_02_justification: The maintainer's project, review, security, release, infrastructure, and support responsibilities are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/governance.md
osps_gv_03_02_justification: Contribution scope, setup, validation, testing, generated-artifact, PR, review, licensing, and conduct requirements are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_le_01_01_justification: All contributions are made through GitHub. GitHub Terms section D.6 states that each repository contribution is licensed under the repository license and the contributor agrees they have the right to license it. Blanc's contributor guide repeats the authorization requirement. https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-terms-of-service#6-contributions-under-repository-license
osps_qa_03_01_justification: Protected main requires an up-to-date PR with substrate, acceptance-wiring, oauth-compatibility, and CodeQL javascript checks; admins are included and bypasses remain visible. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-project-safeguards-2026-09-04.md
osps_qa_06_01_justification: Required PR CI runs unit, compliance, acceptance-wiring, OAuth compatibility, and CodeQL checks before merge. Contributors can run the same tests locally: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_sa_01_01_justification: The v1.17.0 security assessment identifies people, untrusted sites, privileged renderers/processes, operating-system integrations, services, and release actors with their actions and trust transitions: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md
osps_sa_02_01_justification: Desktop protocols, local origins, consumed services, Worker HTTP APIs, MCP and companion interfaces, payloads, responses, and data flows are indexed at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#released-external-interfaces
osps_sa_03_01_justification: The current assessment records likely high-impact threats, existing controls, residual risks, v1.17.0 release evidence, and review triggers: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md
osps_vm_01_01_justification: SECURITY.md defines coordinated private reporting, two-day acknowledgement and five-day assessment targets, severity-based remediation targets, disclosure coordination, and safe harbor: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/SECURITY.md
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Security researchers can report privately to support@blancbrowser.com with Security in the subject under https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/SECURITY.md
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Confirmed vulnerabilities are published through GitHub Security Advisories and linked or summarized in release notes with affected/fixed versions, impact, and update guidance. Earlier findings are public in the assessment. Policy: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/SECURITY.md#public-vulnerability-record
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Workflow-wide access is read-only and write scopes are granted only to the release, attestation, deployment, or issue-management jobs that use them. The policy and resource ownership are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-maintenance-policy.md
osps_br_01_04_justification: The release workflow validates its collaborator-supplied mode, platform, and release tag in a credential-free job before any publishing job uses those values. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-windows-linux.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: Every compiled asset filename and updater manifest is version-bound, and SHA256SUMS associates every asset digest with the same immutable release. Current evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/releases/tag/v1.17.0
osps_br_07_02_justification: Storage, access, least-privilege, rotation, revocation, and incident requirements for project credentials are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-maintenance-policy.md#secrets-and-credentials
osps_do_03_01_justification: Blanc documents SHA-256 and Sigstore verification commands, expected success output, native signature checks, provenance, and each check's limits at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/release-verification.md
osps_do_03_02_justification: Release verification pins the expected Sigstore workflow identity and issuer and the expected Apple and Windows publisher identities at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/release-verification.md
osps_do_04_01_justification: Blanc supports the newest public stable release until the next stable release is published. Supported platforms, features, services, exclusions, and channels are documented at https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
osps_do_05_01_justification: A version stops receiving security updates when a newer stable Blanc release is published; only the newest release is supported. Policy: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
osps_gv_04_01_justification: Identity, contribution-history, security-conduct, need, least-privilege, decision-record, and service-principal checks are required before sensitive access is granted. Policy: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/governance.md
osps_qa_02_02_justification: Every release includes a CycloneDX SBOM for the shipped dependency graph and the authenticated manifest covers the SBOM and all compiled platform assets. Current evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/releases/tag/v1.17.0
osps_qa_04_02_justification: Blanc has one source repository. The desktop app, site, Workers, and companion sources used by the project all reside in bnfy/blanc, so no additional source-code subproject repository is compiled into a release.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: Contributor documentation identifies the local and CI test commands, when platform tests apply, what dry-run versus desktop tests exercise, and how to report incomplete coverage: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changes-and-validation
osps_qa_06_03_justification: The contributor policy defines major changes and requires an automated test of changed behavior and its important failure case: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changes-and-validation
osps_qa_07_01_justification: Blanc currently has one human maintainer and branch protection requires zero approving reviews. This control requires a second qualified human collaborator and a required non-author approval before every merge.
osps_sa_03_02_justification: The maintained threat model and attack-surface assessment covers actors, trust boundaries, external interfaces, critical threats, controls, residual risks, evidence, and new/breaking-feature review triggers: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md
osps_vm_04_02_justification: Known component findings assessed as non-affecting are recorded with machine-readable status, justification, and impact statements in https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/security/openvex.json; the blocking dependency audit reads that VEX document directly.
osps_vm_05_01_justification: The policy blocks malicious packages, high/critical vulnerability findings, and shipped dependency-license compliance violations, with documented VEX requirements for non-affecting findings: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-maintenance-policy.md#dependency-and-license-analysis
osps_vm_05_02_justification: The policy prohibits a release with unresolved dependency-policy violations or stale license evidence, and release jobs enforce the same compliance inputs. Policy: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-maintenance-policy.md#dependency-and-license-analysis
osps_vm_05_03_justification: Every pull request and push to main runs the required substrate job, which evaluates all four npm lockfiles and fails on unsuppressed high/critical or unidentified dependency advisories. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/.github/workflows/parity-guards.yml
osps_vm_06_01_justification: The SAST policy defines critical and high CodeQL findings as violations and requires a specific recorded rationale for false-positive, test-only, or non-exploitable dismissals: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/blob/main/docs/security-maintenance-policy.md#static-analysis
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL runs on every pull request, and active repository ruleset 23236533 blocks merges on analysis errors or high-or-higher security alerts. PR #352 resolved the production findings; the sole dismissed finding is GitHub-classified test code with a recorded used-in-tests rationale. Evidence: https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/pull/352
